title: He Thought She Betrayed Him - Then Discovered the Son She Risked Everything to Hide
genre: modern-day romance melodrama set in an American city (hospital, rich family, poverty)
premise: Five years ago Lynn Scott, a poor college girl, loved Ethan Montgomery, heir of the rich Montgomery family. His mother Victoria framed Lynn's mother as a thief, blinded her, drove Lynn's sister Tina out of school, and pushed pregnant Lynn off a cliff into the ocean. To protect Ethan, Lynn pretended to leave him for another man while he was in a wheelchair. She survived and secretly raised their son Noah (5, leukemia, needs a bone marrow match), working several jobs. Her friend Dr. Henry Hale helped her and signed as Noah's legal father. Now Ethan is a surgeon (Dr. Montgomery) at the hospital where Noah is treated, engaged to Sierra Vance. He meets Noah, believes Noah is Henry's son, then learns the truth, exposes Victoria, and in the end marries Lynn. Lynn narrates much of the story; Ethan also narrates some inner thoughts.
